### 🟡 Changes recommended Add bounded or evicting cache behavior and validate large-pattern memory usage before approval. *Once you've addressed the issues Copilot identified, you can request another Copilot review.*
Pull request overview This pull request reuses non-bind RHS scans across capped seed blocks for ASK/LIMIT execution while preserving sort metadata and budget behavior. **Changes:** - Adds query-local RHS scan caching with sort invalidation. - Refactors joins to borrow cached bindings. - Adds focused correctness and reuse tests.
File summaries | File | Summary | |---|---| | `crates/sparq-engine/src/exec.rs` | Implements RHS scan reuse, borrowed joins, and tests; the cache currently has unbounded retention and may cause peak-memory regressions. |
